get.description: Returns calls for a workspace with filters, sorting, pagination, and export support. Requires the `calls:read` permission; `export=true` returns an unpaginated file and additionally requires `calls:export`. Rows omit `summary` and carry the first 280 characters of `reviewNotes` unless `include` asks for them; tags carry no `metadata`.

put.description: Sets or clears one value of an insight already defined in the workspace on one call, for example a corrected result code. Insights the platform writes (tool fields, workflow variables) are refused, so the sent value stays as evidence. The value is stored in the insight's type; list insights accept only their own values. Each write is recorded in the audit log.

post.description: Queues a lossless dump of calls + related sub-tables + recordings + debug blobs + upstream FK targets (agents/workflows/versions) for round-trip with the import endpoint. The selection is frozen at request time and the ZIP is generated by the export worker: poll `GET /export/{jobId}` and collect it from `GET /export/{jobId}/download` (only the requesting account can collect a raw bundle). The ZIP contains calls.json, agents.json, workflows.json, versions.json, recordings/<callId>[_user|_assistant].{opus,mp3,wav}, and traces/<callId>.json.gz + logs/<callId>.json.gz (gzip-compressed OTel traces and application logs, management only). Workspace-scoped; requires the `calls:export` permission.

post.summary: Import calls from a raw ZIP export
post.description: Accepts a multipart/form-data upload of a ZIP archive produced by /call/export-raw. Phase A inserts bundled workflows/agents/versions (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, flagged is_imported) so imported calls preserve their call → agent → workflow → version FK chain inside the target workspace. Phase B creates calls (flagged is_imported), uploads recordings to the target workspace S3 path, and inserts related tags/feedbacks/assertion results. Workspace-scoped; requires the `calls:import` permission.

post.description: Sends an email invitation to join the workspace. The invitee can accept within 7 days. The invitation token travels by email only; the response carries a join link solely when no email will be sent (skipEmail, or a deployment with invite email switched off) and the caller holds workspace:settings-write. Inviting an address that has no account yet with no delivery channel at all is refused with 403, and a failed send to such an address rolls the invitation back and answers 502.

post.summary: Fork a chat call at an anchor
post.description: Creates a brand-new chat call that copies the parent call's messages up to and including `fromMessageId` and retargets a different `versionId`, `agentId`, or `workflowId`. The forked call is dormant until the caller drives it via POST /chat/message. Cross-entity forks are allowed; the inherited workflowSnapshot may be partially incompatible with the new target (pipecat's resume path degrades gracefully).

403.description: Workspace ID mismatch or insufficient permissions

404.description: Parent call, anchor message, or target version not found

post.description: Closes a chat call. Tells pipecat to fire the end-of-call lifecycle (webhook + post-conversation analysis + end-of-call tools) — analysis runs async on pipecat; the webhook arrives at the dashboard shortly after with summary, sentiment, themes, problems, and assertions. Idempotent: a second call on an already-ended call returns 200 with `alreadyEnded: true` without re-triggering pipecat.
